item.title: U.S. strikes two Iranian-flagged tankers as tensions continue amid ceasefire
item.description: The Trump administration said it was anticipating a reply from Tehran on its latest terms for ending the war. Iran said the U.S. proposal is still under review.

item.title: Trump calls Iran’s response to peace plan ‘unacceptable’ as ceasefire is tested
item.description: Secretary of State Marco Rubio said recently that he hoped the response would be a “serious offer.”

item.title: Iran war threatens the dream of a post-oil economy in the Gulf
item.description: The conflict is not only sapping oil revenue, but also Gulf states’ efforts to expand their economies beyond it.
